mapper.select: SELECT tdm96_change_detail_id AS change_detail_id , tdm96_window_item_nm AS window_item_name , CASE tdm96_column_nm WHEN 'tdm10_task_class_cd' THEN COALESCE(f_cdnm('TdmTaskClassCode', tdm96_before_data, tdm95_company_id, tdm95_change_date::date), tdm96_before_data) WHEN 'tdm10_task_type_cd' THEN COALESCE((SELECT tdm14_task_type_nm FROM tdm14_task_type WHERE tdm14_company_id = tdm95_company_id AND tdm14_task_type_cd = tdm96_before_data), tdm96_before_data) WHEN 'tdm20_role_type' THEN COALESCE(f_cdnm('TdmRoleType', tdm96_before_data, tdm95_company_id, tdm95_change_date::date), tdm96_before_data) WHEN 'tdm20_ceo_role_id' THEN COALESCE((SELECT tdm20_role_nm FROM tdm20_role WHERE tdm20_role_id = tdm96_before_data::numeric), tdm96_before_data) ELSE tdm96_before_data END AS before_data , CASE tdm96_column_nm WHEN 'tdm10_task_class_cd' THEN COALESCE(f_cdnm('TdmTaskClassCode', tdm96_after_data, tdm95_company_id, tdm95_change_date::date), tdm96_after_data) WHEN 'tdm10_task_type_cd' THEN COALESCE((SELECT tdm14_task_type_nm FROM tdm14_task_type WHERE tdm14_company_id = tdm95_company_id AND tdm14_task_type_cd = tdm96_after_data), tdm96_after_data) WHEN 'tdm20_role_type' THEN COALESCE(f_cdnm('TdmRoleType', tdm96_after_data, tdm95_company_id, tdm95_change_date::date), tdm96_after_data) WHEN 'tdm20_ceo_role_id' THEN COALESCE((SELECT tdm20_role_nm FROM tdm20_role WHERE tdm20_role_id = tdm96_after_data::numeric), tdm96_after_data) ELSE tdm96_after_data END AS after_data FROM tdm96_change_detail INNER JOIN tdm95_change_history ON tdm95_change_history_id = tdm96_change_history_id WHERE tdm96_change_history_id = #{changeHistoryId} AND tdm95_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm96_column_nm NOT IN ( 'tdm12_task_id' , 'tdm13_task_id', 'tdm13_task_relate_detail_id' , 'tdm20_ceo_role_id' ) ORDER BY tdm96_change_detail_id
